description: Calculate the present-day value of a مهریه: coins at the live market rate, and any cash portion adjusted by the Central Bank index (تبصرهٔ مادهٔ ۱۰۸۲ قانون مدنی). Never guess coin prices or the adjustment index — this tool reads both from the database. If there is a cash portion, ask for marriage_year; without it the cash stays nominal and must not be called «ارزش روز».

coin_type.description: Coin type (default azadi = تمام بهار آزادی).

coins.description: Number of coins in the مهریه.

marriage_year.description: Jalali marriage year (needed to adjust the cash portion to today's value).

name: calculate_mahrieh
title: محاسبهٔ مهریه به نرخ روز — Calculate mahrieh at today's value
